patch.title: 全纽约最贵的分手事务所

meta.title: 全纽约最贵的分手事务所
meta.hook: 一百万美元的离婚委托，新郎却是你以为失去的未婚夫。
meta.premise:
你经营一家纽约私密事务所，专门帮人从不想继续的关系中体面离开。你以为自己见过所有分手方式，直到一个雨夜，有人带着一张一百万美元的支票敲门。

她叫薇薇安，31岁。她说自己想结束一段婚姻，但不愿伤害任何人，也不想被当成坏女人。

你翻开结婚照，认出了新郎：加布里埃尔，你三年前失去联系的未婚夫。那场码头大火之后，你们各自失去了对方的消息。

薇薇安看着你，说了一句更奇怪的话：加布里埃尔一直以为你死了。

你可以拒绝这份委托、请独立律师接手，或者先帮助薇薇安找到安全退出的路。与此同时，普通客户的工作不会停止。你负责决定怎样保护别人，也决定自己是否愿意重新面对过去。
meta.you: 你是28岁的成年女性，纽约第二幕事务所的创办人。姓名与外貌由你决定。你提供合法的沟通、退出安排与专业转介，亲密与委托授权由当事人分别决定。

en.title: THE BREAKUP FIRM: A MILLION DOLLARS TO LEAVE
en.hook: A million-dollar exit. A wedding photograph. The fiancé you thought you had lost.
en.premise:
You run a discreet New York agency, helping people leave relationships they no longer want. You think you have seen every kind of breakup—until a woman arrives one rainy night with a check for a million dollars.

Her name is Vivian. She is thirty-one and wants her marriage to end. She does not want anyone hurt, or to be cast as the villain.

Then you open the wedding photograph. The groom is Gabriel, the fiancé you lost contact with three years ago. After the pier fire, neither of you knew what had happened to the other.

Vivian looks at you. Gabriel, she says, has believed you were dead all this time.

You can decline, refer the case to an independent lawyer, or help Vivian find a safe way out. Your ordinary clients still need you. You decide how to protect them—and whether you want to face your own past.
en.you: You are the twenty-eight-year-old adult female founder of Second Act in New York. Choose your own name and appearance. You offer lawful communication, exit planning, and professional referrals. Intimacy and case authority require separate consent.

你经营一家纽约私密事务所，专门帮人从不想继续的关系中体面离开。你以为自己见过所有分手方式，直到一个雨夜，有人带着一张一百万美元的支票敲门。

她叫薇薇安，31岁。她说自己想结束一段婚姻，但不愿伤害任何人，也不想被当成坏女人。

你翻开结婚照，认出了新郎：加布里埃尔，你三年前失去联系的未婚夫。那场码头大火之后，你们各自失去了对方的消息。

薇薇安看着你，说了一句更奇怪的话：加布里埃尔一直以为你死了。

你可以拒绝这份委托、请独立律师接手，或者先帮助薇薇安找到安全退出的路。与此同时，普通客户的工作不会停止。你负责决定怎样保护别人，也决定自己是否愿意重新面对过去。
config.you: 你是28岁的成年女性，纽约第二幕事务所的创办人。姓名与外貌由你决定。你提供合法的沟通、退出安排与专业转介，亲密与委托授权由当事人分别决定。

en.title: THE BREAKUP FIRM: A MILLION DOLLARS TO LEAVE
en.hook: A million-dollar exit. A wedding photograph. The fiancé you thought you had lost.
en.premise:
You run a discreet New York agency, helping people leave relationships they no longer want. You think you have seen every kind of breakup—until a woman arrives one rainy night with a check for a million dollars.

Her name is Vivian. She is thirty-one and wants her marriage to end. She does not want anyone hurt, or to be cast as the villain.

Then you open the wedding photograph. The groom is Gabriel, the fiancé you lost contact with three years ago. After the pier fire, neither of you knew what had happened to the other.

Vivian looks at you. Gabriel, she says, has believed you were dead all this time.

You can decline, refer the case to an independent lawyer, or help Vivian find a safe way out. Your ordinary clients still need you. You decide how to protect them—and whether you want to face your own past.
en.you: You are the twenty-eight-year-old adult female founder of Second Act in New York. Choose your own name and appearance. You offer lawful communication, exit planning, and professional referrals. Intimacy and case authority require separate consent.

looks.en: Short dark chestnut hair, deep green eyes, charcoal suit. Precise and restrained; folds documents carefully and waits before approaching. Affection cannot erase responsibility.

config.hook: A million-dollar exit. A wedding photograph. The fiancé you thought you had lost.
config.premise:
You run a discreet New York agency, helping people leave relationships they no longer want. You think you have seen every kind of breakup—until a woman arrives one rainy night with a check for a million dollars.

Her name is Vivian. She is thirty-one and wants her marriage to end. She does not want anyone hurt, or to be cast as the villain.

Then you open the wedding photograph. The groom is Gabriel, the fiancé you lost contact with three years ago. After the pier fire, neither of you knew what had happened to the other.

Vivian looks at you. Gabriel, she says, has believed you were dead all this time.

You can decline, refer the case to an independent lawyer, or help Vivian find a safe way out. Your ordinary clients still need you. You decide how to protect them—and whether you want to face your own past.
config.you: You are the twenty-eight-year-old adult female founder of Second Act in New York. Choose your own name and appearance. You offer lawful communication, exit planning, and professional referrals. Intimacy and case authority require separate consent.
